title: Disentangling Forgetting from Utility: Lightweight LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Null-Space Projection
abstract: arXiv:2611.17864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific knowledge without compromising general utility. However, prevailing fine-tuning-based unlearning methods struggle to achieve this balance, often suffering from computational inefficiency and unintended utility degradation due to the entangled nature of knowledge within model parameters. To disentangle forgetting from utility, we propose UUE, a theoretically grounded framework that reformulates unlearning as controllable model editing. First, UUE projects parameter updates into the orthogonal left null space of retained knowledge representations, strictly ensuring that the editing process causes minimal interference to the model's general capabilities. translated_title: 将遗忘与效用解耦：基于正交零空间投影的轻量级大语言模型遗忘
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）因保留私人或危险信息而带来重大安全风险，这迫切需要能够在不损害整体效用的情况下删除特定知识的遗忘技术。然而，主流的基于微调的遗忘方法难以实现这种平衡，由于模型参数中知识的纠缠特性，这些方法往往存在计算效率低下和效用意外下降的问题。为了将遗忘与效用解耦，我们提出了UUE，这是一个具有理论基础的框架，它将遗忘重新表述为可控的模型编辑。首先，UUE将参数更新投影到保留知识表示的正交左零空间中，严格确保编辑过程对模型的通用能力造成最小干扰。其次，与有目标的映射不同，我们引入了一个凸的无目标目标函数，该函数推导出闭式解析解……
tldr: UUE框架通过将参数更新投影到保留知识的正交左零空间并引入具有闭式解的凸无目标目标函数，实现了在不损害模型通用能力前提下的高效轻量级LLM知识遗忘。
